rows.question: I'm a 2nd-year bachelor's student at PNU and I don't have TOPIK level 3 yet. How many hours per week am I allowed to work part-time?
rows.answer: As a 2nd-year bachelor's student without TOPIK level 3, you are allowed to work up to 10 hours per week part-time. If you meet other requirements, you could potentially work more hours by improving your Korean proficiency.
